Encroachment removal drive starts near Jama Masjid after court order

An encroachment removal drive has commenced in the vicinity of Jama Masjid in Delhi, following an order from the Delhi High Court. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) is carrying out the operation. The drive has already resulted in the clearing of three parks. The action is specifically targeting encroachments around the mosque.
